turns.question: What share of candidates who applied in September 2026 reached the interview stage or beyond?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for the share of applicants who reached the interview stage or beyond, so I can't give that share; the closest metrics are Applications and Candidates in stage: 3 candidates applied from 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30 (Applications), of whom 2 are now at hired and 1 at rejected by current stage (the current stage doesn't show whether the rejected candidate reached interview first). Late: recruitment.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
